messages.subject: caption above chart?
parts:
Hi

I love the possibility to indicate in the chunk the figure caption.
however, I personally prefer to have them above, and not below the
chart.

is there any possibility to change this? I tried understanding
fig.cap, but doing
>knit_hooks$get("fig.cap")
NULL

did not tell me much... should one change that hook? How can one see
the default value?

Also I saw there is the possibility to set "eval.after". Would it be a
way to change this, by having a eval.before, so that the caption comes
before (althout I am afraid would be out of \befin{figure} ?)

Thanks!!

messages.author: e7658bf6e6befd70
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] caption above chart?
parts:
fig.cap is not a hook; it is a chunk option:
http://yihui.name/knitr/options and eval.after has nothing to do with
captions

Currently there is no easy way to do this (it is certainly possible
via the plot hook, but you will end up with copying a large amount of
my code); I would recommend you to search for LaTeX packages which may
move the caption above a figure

The other way is not to use fig.cap, and you just write the caption by
yourself, e.g.

\begin{figure}
\caption{This is a caption above the figure}
<<a-plot, echo=FALSE>>=
plot(1)
@
\end{figure}

Regards,
Yihui
